name: Boulderslide Ravine
summary: Kobolds dig furiously for Resonite in Boulderslide Ravine, deep in the Stonetalon Mountains. From Sun Rock Retreat, Mor'rogal sends Horde scouts into the caves for samples, troubled by a growing tension in the earth.

sections.title: Tension in the Stone
sections.body: At Sun Rock Retreat, Mor'rogal watches the Stonetalon peaks with concern. The earth feels disturbed, with an unnatural agitation rising from the southeast. In Boulderslide Ravine, kobolds have left their usual foraging to dig aggressively for Resonite, a rare mineral found beneath the surface. Mor'rogal sends Horde scouts past the kobolds and into the cave's deepest reaches to learn why they mine with such frenzy. He asks them to bring back raw samples.

sections.title: Awakening the Ancients
sections.body: Raw Resonite crystals hum with ancient Earthen magic. The kobolds have dug into a layer of the deep stone and uncovered an Earthen, one of the primordial stone-beings the Titans shaped to form Kalimdor's subterranean foundations. Their mining has disturbed a relic of primordial history. The tauren must act before the buried being breaks free.

faq.answer: Boulderslide Ravine cuts into the Stonetalon Mountains southeast of Sun Rock Retreat. Its winding caves are overrun with Boulderslide kobolds.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Boulderslide Ravine?
faq.answer: Mor'rogal, a tauren at Sun Rock Retreat, gives the task. Sun Rock Retreat is the main Horde outpost in the Stonetalon Mountains.
Resonite is a rare mineral from deep in the Boulderslide cave system. It carries traces of Titan-forged Earthen magic, a sign that the crystals formed near subterranean Earthen relics.

faq.q: Why are the kobolds mining Resonite so frantically?
faq.answer: The kobolds found Resonite while digging for shiny ores. Their digging carried them deep beneath the mountains, where they disturbed an ancient Earthen buried in the rock.

faq.q: What is an Earthen according to tauren lore?
faq.answer: Mor'rogal's ancient lore calls the Earthen stone-hewn creatures the Titans forged long ago to carve and shape the world's bedrock.

faq.q: What happens after completing this quest?
faq.answer: After finding Earthen magic in the Resonite crystals, Mor'rogal prepares an enchanted countermeasure. He sends you back into the cavern to face the awakened threat.

angles.text: As a tauren who reveres the Earth Mother, you may see ancient Titan workings beneath the mountains as a dangerous disturbance in Stonetalon's natural balance.
As a shaman who listens to the earth, you can sense an unnatural resonance through the rock as kobolds uncover relics of primordial Titan elemental craft.
As a miner, you can tell that the Resonite from Boulderslide is no ordinary ore. Its matrix holds ancient arcane residue left by subterranean builders.
